Strict Press
WEIGHT
Heavy 10
STRICT PRESS — BUILD TO A 10RM
6 Sets, 1 Set Every 2:00
Set 1: 6 Reps @ 45–50%
Set 2: 6 Reps @ 55–60%
Set 3: 4 Reps @ 60–65%
Set 4: 4 Reps @ 65–70%
Set 5: 10 Reps @ 70–75%
Set 6: 10 Reps @ Build If Able
Score: Heaviest successful set of 10 reps.
Today we're building to a heavy set of 10 rep Strict Press! We've been putting in a lot of volume throughout this cycle, and today we're challenging ourselves to see how much weight we can move for 10 consecutive reps. This is about building strength, muscular endurance, and the ability to maintain good positions under fatigue.
The percentages are meant to gradually build you toward your 10RM without accumulating too much fatigue along the way.

11:42
Today we're building to a heavy set of 10 rep Strict Press! We've been putting in a lot of volume throughout this cycle, and today we're challenging ourselves to see how much weight we can move for 10 consecutive reps. This is about building strength, muscular endurance, and the ability to maintain good positions under fatigue.
The percentages are meant to gradually build you toward your 10RM without accumulating too much fatigue along the way.
You can attempt your 10RM on ANY set as the weight increases, but you must complete at least the minimum prescribed reps for that set.
If you complete a heavy set of 10 before Set 6, you can take another attempt at a heavier weight. If you're happy with your 10RM, you're done pressing for the day!
Be smart with your attempts. We're looking for 10 challenging, quality reps with consistent mechanics and range of motion from start to finish.

Coming off our 10RM Strict Press, we're continuing to challenge our upper-body strength and muscular endurance, this time with lighter loads, varying directional pressing, and more volume under fatigue. But we get to use our legs.

11:43
HIRAYA
TRAINING HOUSE
HIRAYA TRAINING HOUSE
our legs.
The first 21-15-9 should be fast and steady. Choose a weight you can cycle consistently and manage your Push-ups without reaching failure.
The second half shifts to Push Press and running. Your shoulders will already be fatigued from the Strict Press and Push-ups, so be smart with your sets and use your legs to drive the bar overhead.
Manage your effort early, keep transitions short, and push the pace as the reps decrease. Finish strong on that last 400m!
